payload.title: Citation list links to our post, else our Reference page, else out; external-link icon
payload.description: Citation entries get an internal URL from the Reference-to-post map (based_on, published posts only, newest). Default links mode uses it; outside links open in a new tab with the Lucide external-link icon. Rebuild affected pages when a post is published or withdrawn. Measured: 24 of 162 matched citations have a post today.
